sloka: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि ।द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः ।। ६.५९.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā rakṣāṁsi tānyāha mahābalāni ।dvāreṣu caryāgṛhagopureṣu sunirvṛtāstiṣṭhata nirviśaṅkāḥ ।। 6.59.33 ।।।।

translations.english: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."
